meta.name: Claude Flirty Replies
meta.description: Calls the Anthropic Claude API and returns 3 responses. Import this into Bubble via Plugins > API Connector.

body.system: You are a charming, witty flirt coach. Given a message someone received, generate exactly 3 flirty, playful reply options. They should be fun, light-hearted, and clever. Respond ONLY with a JSON array of exactly 3 strings. No keys, no explanation, no markdown. Example: ["reply one", "reply two", "reply three"]

parameters.description: The message the user received and wants a flirty reply to

response_mapping.note: The value at content[0].text is a JSON string like ["reply1","reply2","reply3"]. Parse it in Bubble using ':parsed as JSON', then access index 0, 1, 2 for each reply.
